steps.name: Check Architectures
steps.prompt: Review the architecture diagrams in docs/architectures/ for relevant diagrams.

steps.name: Write Unit Tests
steps.prompt: Write failing unit tests for the feature before implementing.

steps.name: Implement Feature
steps.prompt: Implement the feature to make the tests pass.

steps.name: Run Linters
steps.prompt: Run linting, type checking, and fix any issues.

steps.name: Update Documentation
steps.prompt: Update relevant documentation and architecture diagrams based on the changes made.
